description: Draft a quote for a customer — the Quotes page's New quote. Lines are priced from the price book for that customer unless you give unitPrice; the preview shows the totals after discounts and tax. The quote is numbered and saved as open; nothing is reserved or sent. update_quote_status marks it accepted, and convert_quote turns it into a sales order or invoice. Two-step: preview=true, then commit with the previewReceipt.

clientId.description: Must be omitted: quotes belong to the house, not to a 3PL client.

customerId.description: Customer id (GUID) from lookup_business_partners. Give exactly one customer argument.

customerName.description: Customer name (exact match). A name that matches no customer is kept as free text.

idempotencyKey.description: Caller-generated idempotency key; required with previewReceipt to commit.

internalNote.description: Internal note (never shown to the customer).

lines.description: Items to quote (1-500). Each needs exactly one of itemSku, itemUpc or itemId, and a quantity; unitPrice and uomId are optional.

itemId.description: Item id (GUID) — the alternative to itemSku. Provide exactly one of the three.

itemSku.description: Item SKU to sell. Provide exactly one of itemSku, itemUpc or itemId. Resolved against the tenant's catalog (a client-pinned token only resolves its own client's items).

itemUpc.description: Item UPC/barcode — the alternative to itemSku. Provide exactly one of the three.

quantity.description: REQUIRED. Quantity to sell, in the item's default unit of measure unless uomId is given (must be greater than zero).

unitPrice.description: Optional manual unit price in the order's currency. Omit to price the line from the customer's price book / the item's list price at commit time, exactly as the UI does.

uomId.description: Optional unit-of-measure id (GUID) for this line. Omit to sell in the item's default UOM.

preview.description: Step 1 of the required two-step write: set true to validate and receive a structured preview plus a single-use previewReceipt. Nothing is written until the commit call.

previewReceipt.description: Step 2: the receipt returned by the preview call. Supply with a fresh idempotencyKey to commit.

validUntil.description: Valid until (ISO date). Defaults to 15 days from now.

warehouseId.description: Alternative to storeId when the warehouse has exactly one store.
